International registries
Explore trials
worldwide
.
While PetTrials focuses on Australian trials, these international registries list hundreds of veterinary studies. Some may accept remote participation or international enrolment.
AVMA Veterinary Clinical Trials Registry
American Veterinary Medical Association
The largest registry of veterinary clinical trials, with 300+ active studies across US universities. Searchable by species, condition, and location. Free to search, no account required.
Search AVMA registry →
Dog Aging Project (TRIAD)
Texas A&M / University of Washington
Landmark longitudinal study of ageing in companion dogs. Includes the TRIAD rapamycin trial testing whether the drug can extend healthy lifespan. Open to dogs across the United States.
Learn more →
VIN Clinical Trials
Veterinary Information Network
Repository of veterinary clinical trials maintained by the world's largest online veterinary community. Primarily US-based studies. Requires VIN membership for full access.
Visit VIN →
